population: Same fixed46clean/moderate CAL frames, including fallbacks and ambiguous initial families
source: Exactly sealed RAW_STAGED/FUSED_SIGMA2_STAGED observations, same fresh FULLCAL46 RGB visibility evidence and cleanTiny support, original frozen weights/gates, geometric-outline seed/order from prior study

intermediate_visible_gate.acceptance: On exact attempted active IDs, J(before)-J(candidate)>existing minimum_gain_px2=1e-7; original rank/spread/depth/initial-motion gates must pass
intermediate_visible_gate.fit: Same original IRLS _fit from current pose with fixed initial prior; no PnP reseeding; no projected observations
intermediate_visible_gate.rationale: Independent measurements excluded from a seed should not veto that seed. Subsequent true observations can improve aggregate active fit while sacrificing residual on previously admitted observations; fixed initial prior keeps the same trust reference.

final_guard.reference: Initial pose evaluated on the immutable full-visible eligible pool with the same frozen weights and fixed initial prior
final_guard.fallback: Walk accepted checkpoints newest to oldest; select latest passing checkpoint. If none passes, preserve exact supplied initial R/t and return accepted=False/used_ids=[]
final_guard.rationale: Final output must improve the initial aggregate robust objective over all independently classified visible observations; local progress cannot escape this final safeguard. Most recent passing checkpoint preserves progression without selecting a minimum by ground truth.

unknowns: Exactly existing residual admission gate and legacy active fit gain/global-visible/protected/heldout validation from current pose. Unknown coordinates remain independent raw/fused observations, never visibility proof. Every accepted unknown checkpoint must also pass final all-visible initial guard to be returned.
order_and_rejected_points: Initial hull flags/seed and nominal remaining order exactly match prior study for each RAW/FUSED. Existing one-pass additions retained: a rejected newly added corner is not silently retried or fabricated; logs explicitly identify skipped/omitted visible IDs.
invariants: Original initial pose/H/model orderedxyz/cf extents/physicalQ/native8channel IDs/center fixed
Frozen raw/fused observations and appearance states/visibility/boundary/accuracy/weights exactly unchanged

scoring: Seal code/protocol/all46x7 predictions before isolatedCAL46 labels; report allframe means/medians/P90, success, stage/seed/omitted/fallback support diagnostics, paired4session clustered bootstrap10000 vs matched legacy/together/initial controls
